contexts.text: For the dowry given to a betrothed virgin was a token of consent on both sides. AC 9184, Signified. AC 9186.
To receive a token for the goods communicated. Signified.
The token, or pledge, here, is sensuous truth.
The reason these presents are confirmations, is that they are tokens of consent on both sides; and therefore it is said, when anything is consented to on both sides, Give me a token.
To surrender her virginity is to give a token that she will love him to eternity.
That virginity is... the token of conjugial love. Explained.
The idea that to these alone is faith given as a token of their election.
